## PRACTICAL APPLICATIONS

## EXERCISE SELECTION

Architectural variances of individual muscles lend support to the notion of the need to adopt a multiplanar, multiangled approach to hypertrophy training using a variety of exercises. Moreover, evidence suggests that regular exercise rotation is warranted to fully stimulate all fibers within a muscle and thus maximize the hypertrophic response.
